fixes.explanation: Yes, baker. Here is what the verse says: "The LORD has opened His armory and brought out His weapons of wrath…" The verse also says this is the work of the Lord GOD of Hosts in the land of the Chaldeans. The armory is His, the weapons are His, and the work is His.
Right, friend. The verse says, "The arrogant one will stumble and fall with no one to pick him up." He falls, and no one picks him up. It's a hard picture, and I think that's the point of it.
The text says the opposite, friend. "A sword is against her false prophets, and they will become fools." (Jeremiah 50:36) The word is fools, not wise. So this one is False.

That's it, baker. "The king of Babylon has heard the report, and his hands hang limp." The verse adds, "Anguish has gripped him, pain like that of a woman in labor." One report and his hands give out.

Yes, friend. "Behold, one will come up like a lion from the thickets of the Jordan to the watered pasture." That's the spot the verse names. I always picture a lion coming out of tall brush when nobody expected it.
